# vpsie_file_smb_user (Resource)

An SMB user of the Files service: a name and password that may be granted on SMB shares served in one VPC. Name the VPC with `dc_identifier` and `vpc_id`, or name a share with `share_identifier` to take the VPC that share is served in. The platform keeps only a hash of the password, so the password is never read back: it stays in the Terraform state (marked sensitive) as configured, and changing it sets a new password and ends the user's open sessions. Grant the user on a share with `vpsie_file_share_smb`. Needs the `fileStorage` licence module.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "smb_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Name the VPC with the datacenter and VPC id, or use share_identifier to take the VPC of a share.
resource "vpsie_file_smb_user" "alice" {
  username      = "alice"
  password      = var.smb_password
  dc_identifier = "replace-with-datacenter-identifier"
  vpc_id        = 42
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password: 12 to 128 characters, a letter and a digit or symbol, not containing the user name. Changing it sets a new password.
- `username` (String) The user name: 3 to 32 lower-case letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, starting with a letter. Reserved names are refused. Changing it replaces the user.

### Optional

- `dc_identifier` (String) The datacenter identifier. Set it with `vpc_id`; with `share_identifier` the platform fills it in. Changing it replaces the user.
- `share_identifier` (String) The identifier of a share whose VPC the user belongs to, instead of `dc_identifier` and `vpc_id`. Changing it replaces the user.
- `vpc_id` (Number) The numeric id of the VPC the user belongs to. Set it with `dc_identifier`. The platform does not report it back, so the configured value is kept. Changing it replaces the user.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the user was created (RFC 3339).
- `identifier` (String) The SMB user identifier.
- `password_changed_at` (String) When the password was last set (RFC 3339).
- `share_count` (Number) How many shares currently grant the user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An SMB user can be imported with its identifier; set password and vpc_id (or share_identifier) in the configuration,
# the platform reports neither. The next apply sets the configured password.
terraform import vpsie_file_smb_user.alice <smb-user-identifier>
```
